name: Plasmodium (malaria)
short_description: Single-celled apicomplexan parasite that causes malaria, spread by Anopheles mosquitoes. Shown here as the invasive merozoite (~1.5 µm): a small egg-shaped eukaryotic cell with a pointed apical complex (rhoptries, micronemes) for entering red blood cells, one nucleus, a single mitochondrion and a relict apicoplast. Not a worm, not a bacterium.
